newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel Treasury seeks 4 bln shekel '98 budget cut.
newsitem.headline: Israel Treasury seeks 4 bln shekel '98 budget cut.

text.p: The Israeli Treasury's budget department will recommend to the government a four billion shekel cut in the 1998 budget, Treasury sources said on Sunday.
The recommended cut would be from the so-called "automatic pilot", which takes the 1997 budget as a base and adds in new commitments from decisions or laws passed during the year.
The cut would enable the government to meet its 1998 budget deficit target of 2.4 percent of gross domestic product, against this year's target of 2.8 percent.
The department will also recommend that the defence budget remain at the same level as in 1997 despite the urging of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu for additional funds, the sources said.
